sessions_active_prev_token_idx.name: sessions_active_prev_token_idx
sessions_active_prev_token_idx.where: "auth"."sessions"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "auth"."sessions"."prev_token_hash" IS NOT NULL

users_identifier_present.name: users_identifier_present
users_identifier_present.value: "auth"."users"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "auth"."users"."phone" IS NOT NULL

columns.expression:
(
    coalesce("serial_number", '') || ' ' || coalesce("vc_number", '') || ' ' ||
    coalesce("mac_address", '') || ' ' || coalesce("barcode", '') || ' ' ||
    coalesce("brand", '') || ' ' || coalesce("model", '') || ' ' || "equipment_type"
  ) gin_trgm_ops

locations_not_own_parent.name: locations_not_own_parent
locations_not_own_parent.value: parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id <> id

files_checksum_unq.name: files_checksum_unq
files_checksum_unq.where: "media"."files"."checksum" IS NOT NULL AND "media"."files"."deleted_at" IS NULL
